author: Kai Moreno
title: Usage CSV export from Console
content:
# Purpose
How a customer downloads token usage as CSV for their own finance team. This is not a platform event archive.

# When to use
How a customer downloads token usage as CSV for their own finance team. This is not a platform event archive.

# What Support does
Console → Usage → Export CSV. P4, Support. If they need a recurring dump to a bucket they own for people who are not finance, ask whether they mean the customer-managed export SOP.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
Console → Usage → Export CSV. P4, Support. If they need a recurring dump to a bucket they own for people who are not finance, ask whether they mean the customer-managed export SOP. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
